info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Employee API
Get a single Employee within a Group

params.name: employee_id
params.description: The Noyo ID or Custom Individual ID of the employee you would like to view

params.name: group_id
params.description: The Noyo ID of the Group the employee belongs to.

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single employee based on the Noyo ID or Custom Individual ID provided.
